about.title: About
about.heading: Low on hype, high on reps.
body: I'm Vansh. I study computer science at BBD University in Lucknow and co-founded WaterPlane, a small team that builds digital work for clients.

I come from a defence background, so I like a plan, a checklist and actually finishing the thing. At 16 I co-founded Juvenile Foundation, which is where I first picked up design, SEO and running a project with other people.
Right now I'm learning data analysis and machine learning properly: Pandas, NumPy, plots, and a lot of staring at messy CSVs until they confess.

projects.name: This site
projects.tagline: A portfolio you charge as you read it.
projects.summary: Six full-screen cells and a charge bar that fills as you move. No framework: Vite, TypeScript, hand-written CSS and GSAP, with a small Web Audio player that fades songs in and out instead of slamming them.
